metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: COQKIF01 crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C158 H330 Dy48 O226 14+,4(C5 H3 O3 1-),6(H2 O1),11(Cl1 1-),H3 O1 1+. Metal?O coordination is not determined because atom sites or bond data are absent. Oxygen-bridged metal connectivity is not established from the available bond table.
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
